Station times — editable

Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · edit any time on the right and the line re-paces live
EDIT LAYOUT — drag stations on the grid (1 square = 1 yard). The green dashed line is the cart path: drag its dots to route carts around the benches, “＋ Cart waypoint” adds a dot, right-click a dot deletes it. “➤ Help arrow”: click the FROM station then the TO station to draw where an operator goes to help; right-click a station to remove its arrows. Click a table then “⟳ Rotate table” to turn it 90°. Zoom: scroll/pinch · pan: middle-drag. Click “Done editing” to save.
